# Accepted claims

### claim-claim-java-assignment
- basis: observed

BoxAssignmentService rejects an unknown depot, boxes over depot shelf capacity and previously assigned boxes, then saves a SHELF-01 ASSIGNED ShelfAssignment, publishes a DispatchEvent and returns a DispatchReceipt.

Evidence:
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/application/BoxAssignmentService.java:1-32
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/application/DispatchReceipt.java:1-7

### claim-claim-java-config
- basis: observed

PropertiesConfigLoader reads depot.code, shelf.capacity.kg and event.topic and supplies NORTH-01, 18 and dispatch.assigned defaults when properties are absent.

Evidence:
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/config/PropertiesConfigLoader.java:1-18
- file: services/fulfillment/config/default.properties

### claim-claim-java-domain
- basis: observed

Depot and FoodBox require non-blank identifiers and positive capacity or weight, ShelfAssignment requires box and depot identifiers, and DispatchStatus enumerates ASSIGNED, READY and COLLECTED.

Evidence:
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/domain/Depot.java:1-10
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/domain/FoodBox.java:1-10
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/domain/ShelfAssignment.java:1-10
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/domain/DispatchStatus.java:1-6

### claim-claim-java-memory-adapters
- basis: observed

InMemoryDispatchRepository stores assignments by box id and returns Optional lookups, while InMemoryEventPublisher appends events and returns an immutable copy of its list.

Evidence:
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/adapter/InMemoryDispatchRepository.java:1-14
- file: services/fulfillment/src/com/marketroute/fulfillment/adapter/InMemoryEventPublisher.java:1-13
